title: Homology of a locally split short complex
statement: Let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $S=(M_1\xrightarrow f M_2\xrightarrow g M_3)$ be a short complex of $\mathcal O_Z$-modules, meaning $g\circ f=0$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $k,b\in\mathbb N$. Suppose $\ker g$ is finite locally free of rank $k$ and $\operatorname{im} f$ is finite locally free of rank $b$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. The image means the kernel of the cokernel map [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-module-cokernel-image]. Assume that every point $z\in Z$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ on which the inclusion $(\operatorname{im} f)|_U\to M_2|_U$ admits a retraction. Then $H(S)=\ker g/\operatorname{im} f$ is finite locally free of rank $k-b$, with natural subtraction.

proof.text: Identify homology with the cokernel of the canonical abelian image-to-kernel map using left homology data and cokernel universal properties.

On each splitting neighbourhood restrict the retraction to the kernel. The resulting image-to-kernel map is split mono. Its cokernel is quasi-coherent. On affine opens the split cokernel sequence gives a product decomposition; its sections are finite projective retracts, hence finitely presented and flat. Additivity of stalk rank gives k-b. Apply the affine finite-local-free criterion, commute restriction with cokernel, and glue over the neighbourhood cover. This uses finitePresentation_projective_sections for affine finite projectivity, Module.Projective.of_split for the retract, and isQuasicoherent_cokernel for quasi-coherence. The already proved LocallyFreeRank declarations isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_isAffineOpen and rankAtStalk_sections_eq, together with Module.rankAtStalk_prod, supply the rank criterion and calculation; isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_iSup_eq_top supplies gluing.

theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_homology_of_locally_split_image
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (S : ShortComplex Z.Modules) (k b : ℕ)
    (hkernel : (kernel S.g).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank k)
    (himage : (Abelian.image S.f).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank b)
    (hsplit : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Z.Opens, z ∈ U ∧
      IsSplitMono ((restrictFunctor U.ι).map (Abelian.image.ι S.f))) :
    S.homology.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (k - b)
